content:
Apple today released a new round of software updates, including tvOS 26.6, HomePod 26.6, visionOS 26.6, and more.

tvOS 26.6、HomePod 26.6 及 visionOS 26.6 即日起陸續推送予用戶

Apple has just released a new round of software updates for its entire device lineup.

This update covers several notable versions, including tvOS 26.6, HomePod 26.6, visionOS 26.6, as well as iOS 26.6 and macOS 26.6.

According to Apple's official release notes, the focus of these latest updates is "performance and stability improvements," and they also include some security patches.

Overall, these updates are expected to make your Apple TV 4K, HomePod, and Vision Pro run smoother than before. However, beyond underlying improvements, this update does not introduce any new features.

The reason is that tvOS 27, HomePod 27, and visionOS 27 will arrive this fall.

The aforementioned new versions and their features were unveiled in June and are currently in beta testing, with an official launch expected in September.

A friendly reminder: tvOS 27 will drop support for two popular Apple TV models. If your device is not within the compatible range, it will remain on tvOS 26.6 and subsequent minor updates going forward.

Have you discovered any new features in tvOS 26.6 or other updates? Feel free to let us know in the comments.
